comprehensive_coverage.rationale: Samples name and compare target shapes, count circle corners, and relate four quarters to a whole, but there is no task that asks students to represent or construct the shapes themselves.

scale_appropriateness.rationale: Shape names, corners, straight edges, halves, and quarters stay at an introductory descriptive level, with no advanced geometry vocabulary or multi-step reasoning.

variant_comprehensiveness.rationale: The set varies shape identification, part naming, edge comparison, and quarter counting, yet all responses are selected answers and none elicits a student-made representation.
